**Early Life & Education** [SRC-755242fd3ce6]
- Elon Reeve Musk was born on 28 June 1971 in Pretoria, South Africa, and grew up with siblings Kimbal and Tosca. [SRC-755242fd3ce6]
His parents are Maye Musk and Errol Musk, who divorced when he was ten [ SRC-755242fd3ce6 ].
- As a teenager he taught himself computer programming and sold a simple video game, Blastar, at age 12 [ SRC-755242fd3ce6 ].
- He moved to Canada in 1989 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ] and later attended university in the United States, studying physics and economics before pursuing entrepreneurial ventures.

**Early Ventures** [SRC-755242fd3ce6]
- In 1995 Musk co‑founded Zip2, an online city‑guide software company [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].
- In 1999 he founded X.com, an online payment company that later became PayPal [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].

**SpaceX** [SRC-c8475b2dac28]
- Musk founded Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX) in May 2002 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].
- Key milestones include the first Falcon 1 orbital flight on 28 September 2008 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ], the first Dragon spacecraft docking with the ISS on 22 May 2012 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ], and the first crewed Dragon launch on 30 May 2020 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].

**Tesla** [SRC-c8475b2dac28]
- Musk joined Tesla Motors in February 2004 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].
- Tesla went public on 29 June 2010 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].
- He has been described as the CEO of Tesla, but the exact date he assumed the CEO title is not specified in the retrieved sources (unverified: no matching retrieved evidence).

**Other Ventures** [SRC-3a72702043ff]
- In 2016 Musk launched Neuralink and The Boring Company, focusing on brain‑computer interfaces and tunnelling infrastructure respectively. [SRC-c8475b2dac28]
- He acquired the social‑media platform X (formerly Twitter) in October 2022. [SRC-c8475b2dac28]
- In March 2023 he founded xAI, an artificial‑intelligence research company [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].

**Recent Highlights**
- In May 2018 Musk was elected a Fellow of the Royal Society [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].
- A Starship booster was successfully caught on 13 October 2024 [ SRC-3a72702043ff ].

**Summary**
Elon Musk’s journey spans from a South‑African childhood marked by early programming to founding multiple high‑impact technology companies: Zip2, PayPal, SpaceX, Tesla, Neuralink, The Boring Company, X/Twitter, and xAI. [SRC-c8475b2dac28]
He has driven advances in online payments, private spaceflight, electric vehicles, brain‑machine interfaces, tunnelling, social media, and AI, becoming a central figure in contemporary technology and entrepreneurship (unverified: no matching retrieved evidence).

Elon Musk Childhood and Parents: Early Life Story
Elon Musk grew up in Pretoria, South Africa, in a family shaped by divorce, technical interests and financial uncertainty. His early programming experiments and move to Canada preceded the first companies that launched his career.
Jordan Ellis August 21, 2026 · Updated August 30, 2026
In this story
Key takeaways
Elon Musk was born in Pretoria, South Africa, and grew up with siblings Kimbal and Tosca.
His parents, Maye Musk and Errol Musk, divorced when he was 10, according to Biography.com.
He taught himself programming, sold the game Blastar as a child and later co-founded Zip2 with Kimbal.
Elon Musk’s childhood began in Pretoria, South Africa, where he was raised with his brother, Kimbal, and sister, Tosca. His parents, Maye Musk and Errol Musk, divorced when he was 10, according to Biography.com’s account of Elon Musk’s early life . As a teenager, he became interested in computers, taught himself programming and sold a simple video game at age 12. Those experiences formed the earliest documented link between Musk’s childhood interests and his later technology career.
Musk was born Elon Reeve Musk on June 28, 1971, in Pretoria. The family circumstances described in available biographies are more complicated than a simple story of effortless privilege. Biography.com identifies his father, Errol Musk, as a wealthy South African engineer and says his mother, Maye Musk, worked multiple jobs—including five at one point—to support the family. These descriptions come from published biographical accounts; they do not establish every detail of the family’s finances or home life.
What Elon Musk’s parents did—and did not—determine
Maye Musk built a public career as a Canadian model and later became widely known in her own right. The supplied biographical record describes her as the oldest woman to appear in a CoverGirl campaign. Errol Musk is identified as an engineer in South Africa. Together, those details help explain the professional environment around Musk, but they do not prove that his parents directed his later business choices.
The family’s divorce was an important event in Musk’s early life. Biography.com says he spent his childhood with Kimbal and Tosca in South Africa and that his parents separated when he was 10. Public accounts differ in how they describe the years that followed, so it is safer to avoid presenting one definitive version of his household arrangements or relationship with either parent.
For readers looking for the broader timeline, the full Elon Musk profile from Newsr covers his later companies and public career. This article stays focused on the childhood, parents and early foundations that came before those ventures.

Early Life and Education of Elon Musk: A Complete Timeline
Share:
By Popular Timelines Editorial Team
· Updated: July 14, 2026
How education and upbringing influenced the life of Elon Musk. A timeline of key moments.
Elon Musk is a visionary entrepreneur and engineer known for his pivotal roles in revolutionizing the automotive and aerospace industries. As the CEO of Tesla, he has been instrumental in accelerating the global transition to electric vehicles and sustainable energy. Through SpaceX , he has disrupted the aerospace sector by developing reusable rocket technology and pursuing the ambitious goal of making humanity multi-planetary. Additionally, Musk has founded or led influential ventures such as Neuralink , focused on brain-computer interfaces, and The Boring Company, which aims to address urban congestion. His acquisition of the social media platform X (formerly Twitter) further underscores his significant, albeit controversial, influence on digital discourse. Musk is recognized for his high-risk, high-reward approach to engineering and his commitment to tackling complex global challenges through rapid technological innovation, positioning him as one of the most prominent and impactful figures in the modern tech landscape.

Musk Moves in with Father Following Parents' Divorce
In 1979, following the divorce of his parents, a young Elon Musk chose to live with his father, Errol, primarily because his father owned an Encyclopædia Britannica set and a computer. This decision would later become a source of regret for Musk, leading to a long-term estrangement between the two.

Arrival in Canada
In June 1989, Elon Musk arrived in Canada , where he stayed with a second cousin in Saskatchewan and supported himself by working various odd jobs, including positions at a farm and a lumber mill.
